compose-run.name: Compose Run
compose-run.description: Run a one-off command in a Compose service

config.composeServiceDescription: Name of the service, as declared in the compose file
config.composeRunCommandDescription: Leave empty to use the image default command. Runs without a TTY (-T): the command must be non-interactive.
config.composeRunNoDepsDescription: Do not start the services this one depends on (--no-deps)
config.composeRunContinueOnErrorDescription: Continue the pipeline even if the command exits with a non-zero code
